### Value quality (judgment)

- **Triggered steps / performerInstruction.** All 29 graded tasks (12 Actions incl. the 7 alerts, 17 ADE Enquiries) carry `ServiceRequest.performerInstruction`; no `trigger … no performerInstruction` WARN. PASS.
- **Descriptions and procedures.** Each says what is monitored and why, and each procedure reads `<code>, <occurrenceTiming>. Patient: … Clinician: …`; `goal.noun_phrase` agrees (script `goalConsistency` yes on all 29). PASS.
- **Script WARNs (14, `precondition … on an action that applies to all patients on therapy`).** Resolved, not defects: each precondition is the drug gate (`result_of(...)` of the regimen or P2Y12 Decision), so `all_patients_on_therapy` = every patient on the drug the label covers. Re-checked each gate against its drug: PPI monitors = the four PPI regimens (identical to `Prescribe_PPI`'s precondition); Spinal_Epidural_Hematoma and Renal_Function = low-dose rivaroxaban + the two DOAC regimens; Perioperative_Interruption = every regimen but aspirin monotherapy; TTP = clopidogrel or prasugrel; CYP2C19 = clopidogrel (identical to `Prescribe_Clopidogrel`); Antiplatelet_Hypersensitivity = every regimen with an antiplatelet; the three ticagrelor monitors = Ticagrelor.
- **monitored_target (29 tasks).** Every target names what is monitored and the therapy task(s) whose goal it serves; `Monitor_NSAID_Avoidance`, `Monitor_PPI_Continued_Need` and `Monitor_Bleeding` name the `avoid` goals of `Advise_Avoid_Chronic_NSAIDs` / `Prescribe_PPI` (both `goal.verb=avoid`); `Monitor_Ischemic_Events` names the seven `achieve` drug actions; each ADE Enquiry names its drug action(s) as the adverse-effect source; each alert names its suspicion, its Enquiry and the Enquiry's therapy actions. PASS.
- **Coding.** No missing-coding WARN. **WARN-J1 (carried, unchanged):** `Monitor_Perioperative_Interruption`, its alert and `suspected_perioperative_interruption` are coded `SCT:110265006 [Postoperative hemorrhage (disorder)]`, the bleeding half of "perioperative bleeding or thrombosis". The data item's description explains it; the Enquiry's and alert's texts do not. Baseline content accepted in the 2026-11-03 coding review and required by Phase 3c item 7 (alert = Enquiry concept), so not a FAIL. Data-item codings that are partial or broader (`bowel_or_bladder_dysfunction`, `breathing_pauses_during_sleep`, `ischemic_event_on_clopidogrel`, `blood_in_stool`, `on_ssri_or_snri`, `rash_with_fever`, `intolerable_dyspnea`, ...) each explain the choice in their description; `on_digoxin_or_diuretic` is left uncoded with a stated reason (composite flag). PASS.

### Source fidelity

- **FAIL-J1 (prior review) re-verified against PROTONIX §5.6: RESOLVED.** §5.6 asks, when signs or symptoms of CLE or SLE are noted, to discontinue the drug and refer the patient to the appropriate specialist; its only mention of a test is that serological testing (e.g. ANA) "may be positive" and may resolve more slowly than the clinical signs. It orders no test. The alert now says exactly this in its description, `literature_basis` ("mentions serological testing (e.g. ANA) only as a result that may be positive, without asking for any laboratory or imaging test"), `assistant_invention` ("ask for no laboratory or imaging test ... PROTONIX §5.6 mentions ANA only descriptively") and `ServiceRequest.performerInstruction` / `goal.noun_phrase` / procedure Clinician part ("the label asks for specialist referral and orders no test, and mentions ANA only as a result that may be positive, so none is ordered"). No other text in the guideline claims §5.6 names no test (`Monitor_PPI_Cutaneous_Lupus` says only "stop the drug and refer"). §10.1 reworded to match ("Tests the sources do not ask for ... ANA, which PROTONIX §5.6 mentions only as a result that may be positive"). Keeping the alert (no ANA test step) matches the approved §10.1 / R6 decision. PASS.
- **WARN-J2 (prior review): RESOLVED.** `Alert_Further_Examination_Ticagrelor_Dyspnea.assistant_invention` now discloses that excluding other causes such as heart failure is the assistant's addition carried over from `Monitor_Ticagrelor_Dyspnea` and not in BRILINTA §5.3 (re-read: §5.3 has no such clause; it mentions pulmonary function testing only as a PLATO substudy that found no effect). PASS.
- **Quote fidelity.** 151/151 verbatim at the cited section (see Method). Alerts' source/quote pairs are byte-identical subsets of their Enquiry's pairs. PASS.
- **Applicability.** Population-scoped tasks carry executable preconditions matching their labels: `Monitor_PPI_Hypomagnesemia` (PROTONIX §5.8, prolonged use or digoxin/diuretics: the 6-month+ regimens, or short DAPT with `on_digoxin_or_diuretic = "yes"`), `Monitor_PPI_Bone_Fracture` and its alert (§5.4, a year or longer: Extended_DAPT), `Order_Serum_Digoxin` (BRILINTA §7.5), `Order_CYP2C19_Genotype` (PLAVIX Boxed Warning / §5.1). No unconditional task with a conditional source. PASS.
- **Negative recommendations.** No `routine_not_recommended` task; the DOAC labels' "clotting tests not recommended for monitoring" is honored (`Monitor_Bleeding`'s performerInstruction forbids PT/INR/aPTT/anti-Xa monitoring; no coagulation test is ordered). The 7 alerts are `symptom_triggered_only` with event-triggered timing. PASS.
- **Label monitoring instructions.** Kept as recommended monitors: renal assessment (PRADAXA §2.4, XARELTO §5.4, SAVAYSA Boxed (A)), magnesium (PROTONIX §5.8), digoxin levels (BRILINTA §7.5), frequent neurological checks after neuraxial procedures (DOAC Boxed Warnings / §5.3-5.4). PASS.
- **The 7 alerts: no-test claim per source.** Re-read every cited section: XARELTO Boxed (B) / ELIQUIS §5.3 / SAVAYSA §5.4 (neurological monitoring, urgent treatment), PLAVIX §5.3 / BRILINTA §5.2 (interruption timing), PLAVIX §5.5 / EFFIENT §5.5 (hypersensitivity reported), BRILINTA §5.3 (no specific treatment, switch if intolerable), PROTONIX §5.4 / §17 (fracture risk, report fractures), §5.6 (above), §5.5 (discontinue, consider further evaluation): none asks for a laboratory or imaging test. PASS.
- **WARN-J5 (new, wording only).** The `knowledge_origin` of all 7 alerts paraphrases Mor Peleg's rule as "a suspected ADE whose sources name no test"; for the lupus alert "ask for no test" is the precise criterion. It describes the rule, not the label, and the alert's own texts are now correct, so not a FAIL. Optional at the next revision.

### ADE findings and test steps

- **Findings (17 Enquiries).** Each Enquiry's data items are the symptoms and bedside findings its metaprops name (trigger / patientInstruction), plus a `suspected_<ade>` item for the 7 no-test ADEs; no laboratory test is a data item. All yes/no items are `text` with range `"yes||yes","no||no"`, default `"no"`; measured items typed with units (`systolic_bp` / `diastolic_bp` real mmHg, `pulse_rate` integer /min); `cyp2c19_status` three text values, default `"unknown"`. Shared findings (`hematuria`, `syncope`, `fever`, `reduced_urine_output`, `joint_pain`) are one item each. PASS.
- **Finding codes.** Every ADE finding has an `SCT:` coding naming the finding it records (or a disclosed nearest/broader concept, see Value quality). Each `suspected_` item carries its Enquiry's concept. PASS (WARN-J1).
- **Tests and LOINC codes.** Bleeding -> Hb 718-7, Hct 4544-3 (Decision); Drug interactions -> `Order_Serum_Digoxin` 10535-3; Renal -> `Order_Serum_Creatinine` 2160-0; TTP -> platelets 777-3, schistocytes 800-3, LDH 2532-0, creatinine 2160-0 (Decision); CYP2C19 -> 57132-3; Bradyarrhythmia -> `Order_ECG` 34534-8; Central sleep apnea -> `Order_Polysomnography` 28633-6; CDAD -> 34713-8; Hypomagnesemia -> Mg 19123-9, Ca 17861-6, K 2823-3 (Decision); Interstitial nephritis -> creatinine 2160-0, urinalysis 24356-8 (Decision). Each step orders exactly the tests its monitor names; all codes and captions exact per `loinc_search`. PASS.
- **Gate conditions.** Each test-step gate is the disjunction of its Enquiry's positive findings (`= "yes"`, `systolic_bp < 90`, `diastolic_bp < 60`, `pulse_rate < 50`), reading nothing else except the approved drug term on `Order_Serum_Digoxin` and `cyp2c19_status = "unknown"` on `Order_CYP2C19_Genotype` (the Enquiry's own item; baseline content); no `*_check_due` item. Candidate arguments `for: true()`. PASS.
- **Display.** `Display_Potential_ADEs` is first; its caption lists 17 items naming the 17 ADE Enquiries in plan order; alerts rightly not listed. PASS.
- **Alerts (7).** Each `Alert_Further_Examination_<ADE>` is `role=ade_alert`, after its Enquiry, gated `(<Enquiry's drug gate>) and suspected_<ade> = "yes"`, with code "further clinical examination for suspected <ADE>", occurrenceTiming "event-triggered, at the monitoring visit when <ADE> is suspected", a performerInstruction to examine and decide on work-up, `instrument=clinician examination`, an `assistant_invention` naming Mor Peleg's know-how and that no test is ordered; each `suspected_` item captioned "Is <ADE> suspected?" and coded with the ADE concept, as is the alert's component. ### Scope and structure (judgment)

Single root plan `ccd_antithrombotic_monitoring` with Enquiry -> Decision -> Therapy plan -> Monitoring plan (three parallel sub-plans), matching the approved full-CIG scope. Built Actions + monitoring Enquiries = `cig-actions`, test Decisions = `cig-test-decisions` (script).
